items.text: Finalize synthesis complete. All five round-3 decisions (all selected option A) are now explicitly reflected in plan.md: (d1) agent-manager GetConversation endpoint ships inside this item's PR scope with scenarios/agent-manager/api/** already in acceptance_allow — see Phase 1 and Section 12 cross-scenario risk entry; (d2) session.json caches conversation locally with per-run LastSyncedSequence, synced from agent-manager on every GET — see Data Model, Phase 2, Phase 4 GET handler behavior; (d3) the conversation tab reuses the clarification polling cadence (3s poll, 90s staleness) via an adapted useOrchestrationThread on useStorePolling — now explicitly called out in Phase 6; (d4) archive is a pure soft-hide with archived_at timestamp, sessions remain fully resumable and editable while archived — see Target End State #11, Scope bullet on archive_at, and Non-goals entry rejecting a status enum; (d5) Created Entities tab renders a compact list with title, kind, status badge, priority, click-through to entity detail — see Phase 6 Created Entities component.

Readiness re-scored against the updated plan. All five dimensions reach 3: problem_clarity (clear drift incident motivation, 5 enumerated user-visible problems); scope_defined (explicit in/out scope including the now-settled cross-scenario inclusion, endpoint list, storage boundary, and multi-run continuity); approach_solid (8 sequenced phases, each with concrete file touch points, data model, and ownership of the agent-manager↔swarm-manager seam); testable (per-phase unit tests enumerated for agent-manager handler, swarm-manager store/handler/naming/client, plus four integration scenarios covering attribution, multi-run continuity, and fork); risk_awareness (nine risks with specific mitigations, including fallback-spawn history cap, stale-run recovery, Ollama fallback, cross-scenario deployment, and Created Entities query-perf escape hatch). No remaining gaps block execution.

Follow-up work (intentionally out of scope for this item, but worth tracking once this ships): (a) migrate the existing clarification flow to consume the same agent-manager GetConversation endpoint so both chat-like surfaces share one pattern; (b) extend the Created Entities tab with an in-memory meta_orchestration_id index on backlog/initiative stores if the filter query becomes hot; (c) consider a one-off importer for legacy orchestration-summary.md files if users want history before this feature existed. None of these are blockers — this plan ships as a self-contained greenfield feature.

plan_updates: Small tightening only: Phase 6 conversation-tab bullet now explicitly states the 3s poll interval and 90s staleness warning (inherited from useClarificationThread) and names useStorePolling as the underlying polling primitive, so the d3 decision is visible directly in the implementation strategy rather than implicit via hook reuse. No content added or removed elsewhere; all other round-3 decisions were already fully reflected in the round-3 plan revision.
